name: aniwala-studio
description: Sanity Studio — the admin panel for aniwala.com
comment:overrides: Transitive advisories inside @sanity/cli that Sanity has not shipped a fix for yet.
Both are CLI/build-time only: they are not in the deployed Studio bundle and not in
the website. npm audit's own suggested fix is `sanity@5.14.1` — a DOWNGRADE out of v6,
which would undo this upgrade to patch two moderate issues that nothing can reach.
These pins are the narrow alternative. All three stay within the dependency's own major,
so nothing's API changes. Remove them once @sanity/cli ships newer transitives.
js-yaml is pinned to ^3.15.2, NOT ^4. The advisory range is <=3.15.0, and 3.15.2 is a
js-yaml.safeLoad(), and safeLoad was REMOVED in 4.0. Overriding to ^4 would turn a
moderate-severity advisory into a hard TypeError on whatever path reads a config file.
Verified: 3.15.2 still exports safeLoad, and npm already resolves it elsewhere in this
tree (via gray-matter) without the advisory firing. Do not 'upgrade' this pin to ^4.
adm-zip is pinned to ^0.6.1 for GHSA-vwc7-r8mq-g2x9 (extraction follows destination
symlinks, so a crafted archive can overwrite arbitrary files). It arrives twice, both
times at 0.6.0 and both times under @sanity/cli - via @sanity/runtime-cli, and via
@sanity/workbench-cli -> @module-federation/vite -> dts-plugin. npm audit's own fix is
`sanity@6.1.0`, a DOWNGRADE out of 6.12; 0.6.1 is a patch on the version already
installed, so no API moves. CLI/build-time only: nothing unpacks an archive in the
deployed Studio bundle and nothing in the website touches it at all.
